package com.csse3200.game.components.projectile
  • Related Packages

    com.csse3200.game.components
     
  • Class
    Description
    ProjectileComponent
    Drives a projectile entity's lifecycle: delegates per-frame movement to a swappable ProjectileMovementStrategy (see that interface for why movement is pulled out into its own type), and despawns the projectile once it has travelled maxRange world units from its spawn point - measured as straight-line (Euclidean) distance from spawn, so this works regardless of whether the configured movement strategy actually travels in a straight line.
    ProjectileHitComponent
    Resolves a projectile's real (Box2D) collisions, replacing a blind distance check: deals damage (and optional knockback) to whatever it actually makes contact with on targetLayer, and stops it dead - no damage - against anything on blockingLayer (e.g.
    ProjectileMovementStrategy
    Defines how a projectile entity moves, decoupled from ProjectileComponent so the movement type of a projectile (straight-line, a slower "follow" shot, a lobbed/bow-arc shot, ...) can be swapped by passing a different implementation, without changing ProjectileComponent or anything that spawns projectiles.
